findings.title: Missing handling for unknown ticket status
findings.explanation: The function accesses ALLOWED[ticket.status] without checking that ticket.status is a key in the ALLOWED dictionary. If a Ticket has a status not present in ALLOWED (e.g., a new enum value added without updating ALLOWED), a KeyError will be raised instead of the intended InvalidTransition, causing an unexpected crash.
findings.verification_note: The `transition` function indexes `ALLOWED[ticket.status]` directly without verifying that `ticket.status` is a key, so an unknown status would raise a KeyError instead of InvalidTransition as claimed.

limitations: The full definition of the Status enum and Ticket dataclass is not provided, so it is unclear whether all possible Status values are covered by ALLOWED.
The definition of the Ticket dataclass is not provided, so potential security implications of copying its fields (e.g., containing sensitive data) cannot be fully assessed.
